note.zh: GPT-5.6-Sol（xhigh 思考档位）在 Codex CLI 0.146.0 中一次生成的程序化体素电影《尘世之重》，模型源码未经修改，耗时 24 分 18 秒。裸 Harness 运行，严格隔离，使用题目固定的离线 Three.js 与电影播放器资源。原交付的自写单文件内联步骤因 JavaScript replacement token 展开发生打包损坏；公开版本仅从同次运行保留的有效 Vite assets 重建 dist/index.html 引用层，并通过带审计记录的 delivery-only repair 发布，原远端对象和本地归档均保留。Chrome 实测可启动播放并推进时间轴。
note.en: A one-shot procedural voxel film, The Weight of Dust, by GPT-5.6-Sol (xhigh effort) in Codex CLI 0.146.0, with model-authored source unchanged, completed in 24 minutes 18 seconds. It ran on the bare, strictly isolated harness with the case's pinned offline Three.js and cinematic-player resources. The authored single-file inliner corrupted the original package through JavaScript replacement-token expansion; the public delivery only reconstructs the dist/index.html reference layer from the same run's retained valid Vite assets through the audited delivery-only repair path, preserving both the original remote object and local archives. Real Chrome verification confirmed playback and timeline progression.
